summary: PR 25 ("Integrate Claude Code Action for test reviews") changes only .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml, confirmed via git diff against the commit's actual parent (5b8bac6), which shows a single 49-line addition to that workflow file (display_report, a --json-schema argument, and two follow-up steps for publishing/uploading the review artifact). No test files were added or modified in this PR, so there is nothing to review under the vacuous-tests taxonomy.
